pr_body:
This commit addresses the issue of missing memory tracking for the BitSet in TopN.Row. Instead of introducing BreakingBitSet, we replace the BitSet with a smaller array of offsets in this PR. Nik suggested to remove that BitSet, but I haven't looked into that option yet.

Closes #100640
Closes #102683
Closes #102790
Closes #102784
